decisive_items: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
response.rationale: R3 directly matches the specific cytologic and architectural features of hepatocellular carcinoma (polygonal cells, high N:C, mitoses, invasion), while R2 is a generic neoplastic label lacking the histologic specificity. The raw spans for R3 are more diagnostic and comprehensive.
